title: Support dependence of a product basis function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis on $\Omega$ indexed by a finite nonempty set $\iota$, with distinguished constant basis index $0_B$. For every multi-index $a\in\iota^n$, the product basis function indexed by $a$ depends only on the coordinates $i$ for which $a_i\ne 0_B$; that is, its values agree at any two points of $\Omega^n$ that agree on all those coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$B$ is a finite Fourier basis indexed by a finite nonempty set
